definitions.explanation: The separation of work processes into distinct tasks performed by different people or groups.

notes:
{分業|ぶんぎょう} refers to splitting work into specialized tasks performed by different people or groups. It can describe anything from household chore-sharing to global economic specialization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {分業|ぶんぎょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to divide labor
- {分業|ぶんぎょう}⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧: division of labor system
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{分業|ぶんぎょう}: international division of labor
- {分業|ぶんぎょう}⟦{化|か}→〜化：28335_ka⟧: specialization (the process of dividing labor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{役割|やくわり}{分担|ぶんたん}→役割分担：10049_yakuwaribuntan⟧: division of roles (focuses on assigning specific roles)
